name: A Tale Spun Around the Fire
summary: Kin'weelay asks you to bring tablet etchings to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. The Darkspear preserve traditions through stories, and Gadrin wants to hear this tale.

sections.title: A Tale Shared
sections.body: Kin'weelay has prepared another copy of the tale if your own is lost. Darkspear stories pass legends to the young, teaching lessons and caution through words spoken aloud. Take the etchings to Master Gadrin, the Darkspear spiritual leader in Sen'jin Village, so he can hear the tale.

sections.title: Gadrin's Thanks
sections.body: After you explain how the I'lalai tablet etchings came into your hands, Master Gadrin listens closely. He is glad Kin'weelay cares about preserving and uncovering Darkspear heritage lost over the centuries. Gadrin notes that the Darkspear separated from the Gurubashi not long ago in the grand span of history, then gives you something Kin'weelay asked him to pass along in thanks.

faq.answer: Kin'weelay asks you to take the tablet etchings to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

faq.q: Why take them to Master Gadrin?
faq.answer: Master Gadrin is the Darkspear spiritual leader, and Kin'weelay says he will want to hear the tale.

faq.q: How do the Darkspear preserve traditions?
faq.answer: The Darkspear pass legends to the next generation through oral storytelling, teaching lessons and cautionary tales.
They are etchings from the I'lalai tablet.
Master Gadrin is in Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

angles.text: As a troll, you bring a tale of Darkspear tradition to Master Gadrin, who values preserving and discovering ancestral heritage.
